title.title: The Correspondence of Esther Roberts Hunt Collins

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of Quaker minister Esther Roberts Hunt Collins is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

div.p: I trust is more deserving the best of riches. I may just inform thee that I have had my health better rather better for about a week then my dear little babe I have at home, it sucks the bottle and is a fine child, the rest of our family is well as usual. From some late recounts provision is more plenty and not so high in Europe which is comfortable to hear; I join in desires that we, the inhabitants of this highly favored land may be grateful receivers of the abundant mercies bestowed.

closer.salute: In much love I conclude, thy tribulated Sister in Gospel fellowship. My daughter’s love is to thee.
